elaine (docs): Heads-up — I'm opening a small playbook PR to consolidate 429 + timeout examples into a single troubleshooting flow. Want to make sure SDK snippets and the migration note for context-limits are included. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1327

sam (eng): Thanks — can you add a minimal JS snippet showing retry-after and fallback to smaller model? I can test later.

michael (devex): I'll volunteer to rewrite the Python SDK snippet for unified backoff + header parsing. cc @jenna (product) for UX note.

jenna (product): We should highlight UX: degrade gracefully with partial responses and show cost tradeoffs. Short blurb in the intro.

elaine (docs): Plan: 1) Add JS + Python snippets 2) New small 'migration' section on context limits with CLI example 3) Link fixes (old /how-to links) 4) run smoke tests from the SDK snippets. Assigning reviewers: sam, michael. ETA EOW. Any blockers?

sam (eng): No blockers. Quick note: the JS snippet should show header parsing like: ```js
const retryAfter = resp.headers.get('retry-after')
if (retryAfter) await sleep(Number(retryAfter))
``` Also show fallback route: `model: 'redwood-small:latest'`

michael (devex): I'll add the Python sample to parse `x-rw-retry-after` and show exponential backoff. Also include an example of trimming context: ```py
prompt = prompt[-2000:]
```

deploy-bot: smoke-test: docs PR 1327 opened by elaine — CI linters passed, snippet tests failed (1).

elaine (docs): Thanks bot. sam — details on failing snippet?

sam (eng): Failing because the JS snippet used `fetch` without checking 429 case. Quick fix: show fetch + loop with backoff. I'll push patch to PR.

michael (devex): pushed python fix + updated snippet tests. Also fixed two broken links in the context-limit page.

elaine (docs): Awesome — updated PR description with migration checklist and runbook link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/runbooks/429-timeout.md

jenna (product): thumbs up :thumbsup: Let's also add a short changelog blurb for the SDK release notes.

sam (eng): merged the snippet patch. re-running smoke tests.

deploy-bot: smoke-test: snippet tests passed. All green.

elaine (docs): Great — final reviewers sam, michael. Will merge after one more ✅. Thanks team!
